spans.s:
m. (-णः)
A name of AŚVATTHĀMA, son of Droṇa.
E.
द्रोण as above, and फक affix; also with फिञ affix द्रौणायणि, or with इञ् affix द्रौणि.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Sown with a Droṇa of grain, (fields, &c.)
f. (-की)
A vessel holding a Droṇa by measure.
E.
द्रोण the measure, ठञ् or ठन् affix; also with अण् and ङीष् affix in the last sense द्रौणी.

f. (-दी)
A proper name; DRAUPADĪ, the daughter of DRUPADA, king of Pañcāla, and the common wife of the five Pāṇḍava princes.
E.
द्रुपद the father of this lady, and अण and ङीप् affixes.
